name: Children's Summer Ballet Camp
description_short: Two 5-day ballet camps for children ages 5 to 12 who have at least one year of ballet training. Each week has a theme and covers ballet plus character dance, stage make-up, choreography, costume design, art, French, Pilates and theater.
